material.description: blocked_by: gap-late-join-snapshot-witness. Facts: rust/crates/server/src/room.rs delta_since returns Delta{tick, units:Vec<u32>} (changed indices only, no record state); lib.rs serve_state emits tick, state_hash, max_units and a unit count only; state_hash is sim.state_hash() and is not recomputable outside the sim. A job cannot reconstruct unit state from snapshot plus deltas. Needs a delta that carries unit records, or a state-hash field in /delta, before the acceptance can be witnessed without a fabricated pass.
material.resolution: verifier gm-orch-3-13-v1 at d045f92: live late-join probe, 30-unit room; /state records match units=30; /delta changed=9 records=9; late peer replaying /state plus /delta matches the sim records by id and field.
